# Breadcrumb

Where a page sits, as links back up the path, with the current page as plain text.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

A named `<nav>` around an ordered list. The current page is text with `aria-current="page"` — a link to where you already are does nothing. Separators are drawn in CSS so a screen reader reads places, not slashes. Long ids are cut in the middle with `middleTruncate`, keeping both ends — the parts people compare.

## Usage

### When to use

- Pages nested two or more levels deep: Workspace / Agents / knowledge-agent / Run #4182.
- Long ids in the path, shortened in the middle with middleTruncate.

### When not to

- Moving between pages of the same list. Use [Pagination](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-pagination--overview.md).
- Switching between views of one page. Use [Tabs](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-tabs--overview.md).
- Top-level navigation between parts of the product. Use [App shell](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-app-shell--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Pass renderLink to use your router’s link.
- Don’t: Link the current page; a link to where you already are does nothing.

### Content

- Use each page’s own title as its crumb, so the trail matches the headings.
- Shorten ids in the middle, keeping both ends: “run_8f3a…c21e”.

## API

### `Breadcrumb` (component)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  |  |
| `renderLink` | `((props: { href: string; className: string; children: ReactNode; }) => ReactNode)` |  |  |

### `middleTruncate` (function)

`run_8f3a2b91c21e` → `run_8f3a…c21e`. Both ends survive; the middle is what nobody reads.

Types: `BreadcrumbItem`, `BreadcrumbProps`

## Accessibility

### Keyboard

| Key | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus from one link to the next. |
| Enter | Follows the focused link. |

### Mola handles

- It is a `<nav>` named “Breadcrumb” holding an ordered list.
- The last item is plain text with `aria-current="page"`, not a link to where you already are.
- The slashes are drawn with CSS, so they are not read out.

### You handle

- Leave `href` off the last item.
- When you shorten a label with `middleTruncate`, make sure the full id is on the page it leads to.

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 2 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
